blurb: Guests take small-group guided eco tours through the Thousand Islands of Cocoa Beach to see dolphins, manatees, and native wildlife in their natural habitat. Tours are on a comfortable, shaded 22-passenger boat with free water and parking. Private charters are available for personalized experiences.
